description: Independent relevance annotations are stored separately from imperfect graph memberships. The graph contains deliberate false-positive and incomplete relationships.

traces.text: A portable AI work partner should recover its project memory after switching model providers.
Provider migration should preserve access to prior project decisions and linked evidence.
A fresh model session can reconstruct project context from persisted memory relationships.
Portable storage devices make local backups easier to carry between computers.
Memory foam mattresses use viscoelastic material for pressure relief.
Model replacement should not imply continuity of authorization or legal responsibility.
Source provenance records where a memory trace was observed and when it was retrieved.
An unavailable source may still have a historical observation showing earlier retrieval.
A source can move without making the underlying claim true or false.
Popular sources receive more citations and therefore may rank highly in search.
Revision history shows that a page changed after an earlier observation was recorded.
A checksum mismatch can indicate that retrieved content differs from an earlier version.
Agent accountability requires attributable actions, review, and decision authority.
A GitHub contribution trail can distinguish requester, executor, reviewer, and committer.
A model may be capable of an action without being authorized to perform it.
Identity continuity asks whether two occurrences are the same continuing entity.
A software model version can change while an application keeps the same product name.
A pseudonymous account can deliberately avoid correlation with a civil identity.

historical source provenance availability and change
